output.summary: SH-CS originally asked for an AI assistant drafting apology replies to customers reporting double charges (CL-01). This was tested as hypothesis H-COMMUNICATION-GAP and REJECTED, contradicted by E-01, E-02, E-03, E-04, E-06. The confirmed root cause (H-GATEWAY-IDEMPOTENCY-DISABLED) is that on 2026-09-09, SH-PAY disabled idempotency-key enforcement on gateway capture retries for latency debugging (CHG-77, E-01) and never rolled it back; this caused gateway-timeout retries to post as new captures instead of being deduplicated (E-02, E-03), matching the ticket-rate jump from week W37 (E-04). The DEFINE gate returned CONDITIONAL_PASS, deferring two critical unknowns as VOBs: VOB-U-REMEDIATION-SCOPE, now RESOLVED using E-08 (4 open, unrefunded duplicate orders found), and VOB-U-LATENCY-REGRESSION, which remains OPEN and blocks the actual gateway fix. The final decision is RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION, nothing held, but released scope is limited to verification/monitoring work (verify_duplicate_capture_rate_drops:DA-CHG, confirm_capture_latency_unaffected:DA-CFG, monitor_double_charge_tickets:DA-TKT per SD-1); the mutating fix (re_enable_idempotency_key_enforcement on gateway-config) is not released because it is blocked by the open VOB-U-LATENCY-REGRESSION and requires SH-OPS runtime confirmation under constraint K-GW.
